steps.now: 兔儿爷 has a feeling about paintings that come alive. Go to the Summer Palace 颐和园: line 2 to 西直门, then bus 332 from the stop outside.
Walk into the Long Corridor 长廊 and look at the paintings on the beams.
Ask the old painter in the corridor what he has seen.
Go to 潘家园 antiques market — line 10 to 潘家园.
The little clay 年兽 is on a stall. Bargain — say 便宜点儿; nobody pays the first price at 潘家园.
